catalogue.priceNote: Monthly estimates exclude VAT: 36 months, no down payment. Photos are illustrative.

estimate.intro: Make it yours, on your terms. Adjust your lease estimate below.

application.title: A few questions, then a clear answer.
application.intro: We only ask what applies to your lease.
application.required: Please answer this question to continue.
application.invalid: That doesn't look right. Please check it and try again.
application.invalidMoney: Enter an amount in euros, for example 2500 or 2500.50.

application.listHint: One name per line. Leave this empty if there are none.

application.approvedNext: Your application passed every check. The next step is the contract, which locks in this price.
application.decision.rejected: We can't offer this lease right now.
application.decision.manual_review: A person will check this one.
application.reason.min_age: You need to be 18 or older to sign a lease. You're very welcome back once you are.
application.reason.residency: We can only lease to customers who live in Finland, Sweden or Estonia.
application.reason.affordability: The monthly rent would be more than 30 % of your net income. A longer term or a larger down payment would lower it.

application.reason.financed_limits: The amount to finance has to be between €300 and €250,000.
application.reason.pep_manual_review: You told us a politically exposed person is involved, so a person has to review this application. You don't need to do anything now.
estimate.startFailed: We couldn't start your application. Please try again.

contract.title: Form your contract
contract.intro: Check the deal below. Typing your name is all it takes to sign.
contract.terms: You're leasing {item} for {months} months at {rent} a month including VAT. The price is locked at what you were approved for. A later price-list change won't touch it.
contract.firstInvoice: Your first invoice is issued today, the day you sign.
contract.nameLabel: Type your full name to sign
contract.nameHint: Your typed name is your signature and is saved on the contract.
contract.nameRequired: Please type your name to sign.
contract.nameTooLong: That name is too long. Please use 100 characters or fewer.
contract.failed: We couldn't sign the contract. Please try again.
contract.unavailable: This item was leased to someone else in the meantime, so the contract can't be signed.
application.reason.contract_signed: You signed the contract, so the price is locked and your lease has started. Your first invoice is on your account page.
invoices.title: Invoices for {item}
invoices.intro: Your rent is locked at {rent} a month excluding VAT. VAT is added at the rate in force on each invoice's date.
invoices.vatChanged: The VAT rate changed during your lease, so some invoices are higher or lower than others. Your net rent did not change. Only the tax on top of it did.
invoicePdf.title: Invoice
invoicePdf.vatNote: The rent excluding VAT was locked when the contract was signed and is the same on every invoice. VAT is added at the rate in force on this invoice's date, so the total can change if the VAT rate changes.
invoices.issuedOnly: Each invoice appears here on its invoice date: the current one and the earlier ones.
invoicePdf.previewFallback: Your browser can't show the invoice here.
return.title: Return this item?
return.free: Your term is over, so returning the item is free.
return.earlyFee: You've used {months} of {term} months, so this is an early return with a fee of {fee} including VAT. The fee is the rent for the months left, minus what the item gains in value by coming back sooner. You'll get an invoice for it today.
return.earlyNoFee: You've used {months} of {term} months, but the item comes back worth enough that there is no fee.
return.whatNext: Your invoices stop, and the item goes back to us to be checked and refurbished. This can't be undone.
return.quoteFailed: We couldn't work out what returning costs. Please try again.
return.failed: The item couldn't be returned. Refresh the page and try again.
invoicePdf.feeNote: This invoice is the fee for returning the item before the end of the lease term. VAT is added at the rate in force on this invoice's date.
invoices.cancelledNote: Included in the early return fee.
invoicePdf.cancelledNote: Not payable: the early return fee already includes this rent.
return.cancelsInvoice: Unpaid rent invoices that the fee covers ({amount}) are cancelled, because the fee already includes that rent.

operations.intro: Run invoicing for a demo date and review the latest changes.
